entities.name: Bolesław I of Masovia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bolesław I of Masovia, was Polish prince member of the Polish House of Piast, Duke of Sandomierz during 1229–1232, Duke of Dobrzyń during 1233-1247 and Duke over whole Masovia during 1247–1248.
